sloka: न मे तत्र मनस्तापो न मन्युः हरिपुंगव ।वागुराभिः च पाशैः च कूटैः च विविधैः नराः ॥४-१८-३७॥
transliteration: na me tatra manastāpo na manyuḥ haripuṁgava ।vāgurābhiḥ ca pāśaiḥ ca kūṭaiḥ ca vividhaiḥ narāḥ ॥4-18-37॥

translations.english: 'O hero O best of monkeys listen to me. I will give you one more reason. On hearing it, I hope you would not be angry with me.
